title: The Red Badge of Courage by Stephen Crane - Easton Press Collector’s Edition
descriptionText: This is a rare and valuable collector's edition of "The Red Badge of Courage" by Stephen Crane, published by Easton Press. This classic book has special attributes that make it a must-have for any serious collector of rare editions. The author, Stephen Crane, is known for his vivid portrayals of military life, and this book is no exception. It is bound to impress any reader or collector who values quality and rarity.
